profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a self-starter who researched and learned HTML and CSS as a teenager. I have worked in retail and customer service for 8 years, 4 of those years in management positions. My time in this industry has given me an eye for design, taught me how to work with others to find creative solutions to problems, and also shown me how to be adaptable and learn new skills very quickly. I have been certified in software engineering by General Assembly, after completing an immersive course. I am proficient in JavaScript and Python and am currently studying Ruby on Rails.


Skills:
JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Python, Sass, Django, jQuery, PyGame, Express, Node.js, React, Heroku, mongoDB, Firebase, GitHub

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
PROJECTS:
Cat About Town | Simple platformer game built with PyGame
● Used PyGame to create a simple, functional game where you can move a character around the screen, jump, and attack enemies. Initial build was done in 5 Days.
● Using Procreate, designed and edited character sprites and game background to display in-game window
● Deployed project info on Netlify, using PyInstaller to package game and allow for direct download on live site.

COOKMarked | Recipe creation and storage website
● Using Django’s intuitive built-in functionality, applied user authorization to allow for multiple users to contribute to the site and allow the creator of the content to make edits or delete.
● AWS hosts images to allow users to upload their own photos directly from their device to display on site.
● Materialize creates attractive and easy-to-read recipe cards, dividing pages into a grid through HTML classes.

Treasury Terrene | An online compendium for Dungeons and Dragons campaigns
● Created pages for different indexed categories of game-related items, connecting to separate collections of BSON data within mongoDB
● CSS creates responsive web design, pages change display size suitable for all mobile devices.
● Deployed v.1 on Heroku after 7 days of development.

BingeList | A mobile/web application that allows you to keep track of your favorite TV shows.
● Collaborated with 3 other developers to create a backend Express API hosted on Heroku, and a front-end React app hosted
on Netlify.
● Firebase implements user authentication and authorization to prevent other users’ data from appearing on the current user’s dashboard.
● Express makes a connection to The Movie Database to pull information during user search, converting JSON to storable information on Google Firebase
positions.insights: Skills: Express.js · Python (Programming Language) · Django · Web Development · JavaScript · React.js · Full-Stack Development
